text:
helen: Heads-up: starting a targeted holdout rerun for q6b-int4 bring-up. Local eval shows a quality dip on our 'long-extractive' and 'instruction-preserve' slices. Need a focused 950-sample pull and a golden refresh to validate. Who can help run curation and set up comparisons?
omar: I can run the sampling. Proposed split: 55% long-extractive, 30% instruction-preserve, 15% code-doc-trunc. Micro-golden: 200 full-golden, rest fast-review.
sara: Sounds good. Suggest we run a two-stage dedupe: exact fingerprint dedupe, then fuzzy semantic dedupe (threshold 0.87) to avoid paraphrase collision in the golden. Last run had anchor duplication.
label-bot: queuing sample job id lb-289999 SELECT id, prompt, meta FROM samplebank WHERE slice IN ('long-extractive','instruction-preserve','code_doc_trunc') ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 950; ETA ~9m. :robot_face:
ops-bot: labeler queue currently ~320 tasks. With micro-golden 200 slots reserved we estimate golden review ~55m, expedited remainder ~1.25x throughput. If golden >250 could push SLA beyond 2h.
helen: Good to know. Please apply dedupe stages: pipeline = [filter_slice, fingerprint_dedupe, fuzzy_cluster(thresh=0.87,min_cluster_size=2), stratified_sample, route_golden(200), expedited_review].
devx-cog: I'll attach comparator artifacts. Plan is to run q6b-int4 outputs vs q8b-int3 baseline and a q6b-int4-fp16 variant. We will collect token-level diffs, rougeL, and a compact failure flag. Pseudocode: ```python
for r in sample:
  a = fetch_out('q6b-int4', r.id)
  b = fetch_out('q8b-int3', r.id)
  c = fetch_out('q6b-fp16', r.id)
  metrics = calc(rougeL, token_diff(a,b), token_diff(a,c))
  emit_row(r.id, metrics)
``` Artifact at s3://redwood-curation/289999/lb-289999/comparator.csv when done.
aeva-bot: Reminder: tag examples with metric "holdout_quant_check_v3" and add provenance header {source:samplebank, pipeline:'lb-289999'} to make dashboard filtering straightforward.
sara: Labeling instructions: stress-check for omission (missing key facts), verbatim truncation, instruction-following (for instruction-preserve). Add three exemplar pairs (good/bad) in the task.
omar: Dedupe completed; fuzzy cluster removed 72 near-duplicates. Routing 200 to golden, 750 to expedited-review. label-bot: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-curation/289999/lb-289999/ (sampled.csv, dedupe_report.txt). :white_check_mark:
devx-cog: Comparator job finished and uploaded: s3://redwood-curation/289999/lb-289999/comparator.csv (summary: long-extractive avg rougeL_delta = -0.028, instruction-preserve avg = -0.062; top regressions ids: 9002, 112, 4771).
helen: Instruction-preserve avg delta crosses our soft threshold (-0.05). We'll run quick triage on top-20 regressions before any rollout. Can ops run an automated diff on function-calling outputs too?
ops-bot: Will attach function-call logs for any sample with "contains_function_call:true" in metadata. Search and bundle to s3://redwood-curation/289999/lb-289999/function_logs.tar.gz. ETA ~15m.
sara: I'll start golden review and prioritize instruction-preserve cases. If structural instruction-following failures >10% in golden, we mark as regression.
omar: Noting that a fair chunk of regressions are where the model omits steps in a multi-step instruction. Add a short rubric bullet: "Does the output list all required steps?"
devx-cog: Also saved token-diff heatmap for top-50 regressions at s3://redwood-curation/289999/lb-289999/heatmaps/top50.png.
helen: Thanks team. Let's reconvene in 50m to decide go/no-go. If instruction-preserve regression persists after patching quant kernels, we'll fallback to q6b-fp16 until root cause fixed. :thumbsup:
